I love her and want to be there for her, but now it seems I've done the opposite."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Remember, it's not always easy to navigate these situations. Has this tension changed how you feel about attending the wedding?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"A bit, yeah. I was looking forward to being part of it, but now it feels awkward."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's understandable to feel conflicted. Being part of her big day is important, but so is your peace of mind."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Exactly.
